messages:
sec-alert-bot: [ALERT] Azure Defender detected StorageAccount 'redwood-prod-backups' with container 'daily-exports' set to allow public list and recently-issued SAS tokens. Severity: High.

anna_cloudsec: saw the alert, looks like a newly created SAS URL leaked in a partner repo. Posting logs now. @alex_ops can you confirm access patterns?

alex_ops: pulling list activity. quick check: `az storage blob list --account-name redwoodprod --container-name daily-exports --auth-mode login`

alex_ops: listing shows multiple GETs from 3rd-party IPs starting 02:15 UTC. There are active SAS tokens with expiry > 90 days. Noted.

sre_miguel: tagging in infra — are these backups or test snapshots?

anna_cloudsec: they were meant to be internal exports for partner ingest. Shouldn't be public.

alex_ops: starting containment: I'll disable public access, revoke SAS, and add firewall rule. Exec commands below.

alex_ops: ```bash
# disable container public access
az storage container set-permission --name daily-exports --public-access off --account-name redwoodprod
# invalidate existing account-level SAS by rotating storage account keys (short term)
az storage account keys renew --account-name redwoodprod --key primary
# assign private endpoint after contain (followup)
```

anna_cloudsec: on rotation: also revoke any stored SAS in Key Vault and remove any long-lived service principal that can create SAS. I'll run a query for recent role assignments.

alex_ops: done with container ACL and key rotation. Confirmed 0 responses to public listing now (ran a test `curl` which got 403).

sec-alert-bot: [INFO] Container ACL changed by alex_ops at 2026-02-23T03:21:10Z.

anna_cloudsec: good. Next steps: 1) Revoke partner SAS and issue short-lived ad-hoc tokens via Managed Identity. 2) Add diagnostic settings to send Storage logs to Sentinel / Log Analytics. 3) Add policy to prevent container public access across subscriptions. 4) Post-mortem and comms.

ciso_jane: agree. We need an incident brief for legal & customer success — did any customer data flow through that container? @alex_ops can you check object list and access logs for PII patterns?

alex_ops: running a selective scan of blob metadata and recent downloads. Preliminary: backups are compressed DB dumps that include internal IDs and non-sensitive metadata; no obvious PII. Will confirm.

anna_cloudsec: assign tasks: alex_ops - confirm data contents and preserve logs to a secure blob for IR; miguel - add deny-policy for public containers and create automation to block SAS with expiry > 7 days; anna - enable continuous export of storage analytics to Sentinel and configure an alert for SAS creation events.

sre_miguel: starting policy work. will push a Terraform change with `azurerm_storage_account_network_rules` and a policy definition to audit/publicAccess. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/412

alex_ops: preserved logs to `ir-archives/redwoodprod/daily-exports/1769203456`. Uploaded a manifest with checksums. No PII found in quick scan, but we'll hand to data-privacy for final check.

anna_cloudsec: communication draft for CS/legal: short summary, scope (container name, time window), mitigation actions (ACL off, keys rotated, short-lived tokens), and recommended customer outreach if PII confirmed. I'll post the draft in #security-comms after we confirm.

ciso_jane: good. Also recommend mandatory rotation for any SPNs that had contributor on that storage account. Put an org-wide advisory to avoid long-lived SAS tokens.

anna_cloudsec: post-incident actions (working list):
- add Storage diagnostic -> Sentinel export (done by me)
- org policy to deny public container access (miguel)
- enforce SAS TTL max 7d (policy + telemetry) (miguel)
- automated detection for large volume anonymous GETs (alert tuning) (anna)
- run IAM audit + rotate any SP keys with excessive perms (alex)
- incident writeup and retro (owned by anna)

alex_ops: all tasks assigned, ETA for full remediation and policy rollout EOD tomorrow.

sec-alert-bot: [CLOSE PROPOSAL] Suggested severity downgraded to Medium pending final data-sensitivity review.

anna_cloudsec: leaving thread open until data-privacy confirms. tagging @data-privacy. thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
